title: who takes part ({count})
query: SELECT id, name, kind, CASE WHEN coalesce(also, '') <> '' THEN ' - also ' || also ELSE '' END AS known FROM people ORDER BY seq

title: read now, and by which way in ({count})
query: SELECT id, has, "at" AS place, read FROM surfaces WHERE coalesce(read, '') <> '' ORDER BY seq

title: not yet read - and what is lacking ({count})
query: SELECT id, has, "at" AS place, lacks FROM surfaces WHERE coalesce(read, '') = '' ORDER BY seq

title: the perfect form, from each angle ({count})
query: SELECT ord, heading, "text" AS says, star || '/idea:' || id AS thing FROM idea WHERE star = 'ecosystem' ORDER BY ord

only: not yet read - and what is lacking

title: toward each angle - the work made standing on it ({count})
query: SELECT i.heading, i.star || '/idea:' || i.id AS thing, count(e."from") AS records, coalesce(max(left(t.says, 70)), 'nothing yet') AS latest FROM idea i LEFT JOIN edges e ON e.to_table = 'idea' AND e.to_star = i.star AND e.to_id = i.id AND e.from_table = 'glimpses' AND e.how = 'where' LEFT JOIN things t ON t.id = e."from" WHERE i.star = 'ecosystem' GROUP BY i.ord, i.heading, i.star, i.id ORDER BY i.ord
